title.narrative: Assam Governance and Service Delivery Program

description.narrative: Government of Assam is working towards building stronger institutions, improving allocative efficiency, enhancing resource generation, scaling-up technology adaptation and enhancing citizen participation. AGSDSP will support the Government's vision by modernizing state institutions to enable development through sustainable finance and efficient service delivery.
The PDO is to strengthen public financial management, delivery of select administrative services and data ecosystem in Assam.
